# Networks in TVB-O

## Datamodel representation

```{python}
from tvbo import Network
net = Network()
net
```

```{python}
from IPython.display import Markdown
print(net.to_yaml())
```

```{python}
network_yaml="""\
nodes:
- id: 0
  label: node_0
- id: 1
  label: node_1
- id: 2
  label: node_3
edges:
- source: 0
  target: 1
- source: 1
  target: 2
- source: 0
  target: 2
distance_unit: mm
time_unit: ms"""

Network.from_string(network_yaml).plot_graph()
```
